en: A vintage black‑and‑white photograph of a historic stone courtyard framed by colonnades and arcades. At the center is a large, ancient-looking façade with a pediment and an arched niche, flanked by columns and smaller decorative arches. Steps lead up from the open square in the foreground, and several people in early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand around the area. Tall buildings with shuttered windows and balconies line the right side, creating an enclosed urban square.
